title: athyrium grammitoides
intro: Athyrium grammitoides, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a type of flowering plant in the fern family (Athyriaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium grammitoides include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium grammitoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
